sky.qualification: Gkunhomdima's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

provenance.source: JPL Horizons fixed 2026-09-03 epoch. J2000 pole prior RA 20.6 ± 1.5°, DEC 46.25 ± 0.32° from satellite-orbit alignment. Arbitrary meridian; 11.05 h photometric period has aliases and is not installed as a qualified sidereal spin.
provenance.qualification: Computed Gǃkúnǁʼhòmdímà Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
